captions.detailed: A tall, rectangular bread maker with a light gray main body and a dark gray control panel on top. The top surface features a light gray, rear-hinged lid with a small view window and a black handle, alongside a stepped black control pod. The control pod houses a central rotating selector knob surrounded by four small, square preset buttons. Inside the hollow main cavity, a small kneading paddle is mounted on a bottom-center spindle.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a tall, near-vertical bread maker. The model must feature a main hollowed-out body, a rear-hinged lid with a window, a front release button, and a stepped control pod with a rotatable selector knob and four pushable preset buttons. Ensure the interior contains a rotating kneading paddle.
captions.factory: The main shell is constructed by subtracting a slightly smaller box from a tall outer box to form a hollow cavity. The lid is made from a rounded box with a central rectangular cutout for the window, attached via a rear-hinged joint. The control pod is modeled as a stepped block on which a conical selector knob and four small rectangular buttons are placed. The kneading paddle is modeled as a small paddle shape mounted on a cylindrical spindle at the bottom of the inner cavity.
